import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    s = data[0]
    result = 0
    i = 0
    n = len(s)
    while i < n:
        j = i
        while j < n and s[i] == s[j]:
            j += 1
        if ((j - i) & 1) == 0:
            result += 1
        i = j
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
